input_protocol.git_object_inputs: Prior delta-0.4 artifacts are loaded read-only from the exact committed Git revision and physical hashes above; no branch merge or artifact rewrite is permitted.
input_protocol.identity_join: Selector candidate_identity must equal prior eligibility-ledger candidate_id and both artifacts must bind the same baseline generator candidate-lock payload d9717fc3a7b92fe8b264c7803c43f50f48b14e078b179cbd75f66d769aa65b10.
input_protocol.eligibility_inheritance: Use the exact prior eligibility Boolean and descriptor values. Do not recompute, relax or supplement eligibility.
input_protocol.score_access: Selector score and rank are ordering provenance only. No task score, docking score, teacher endpoint, teacher transformation or evaluation manifest may be loaded.

selection_semantics.cell_support: A cell is supported only when the immutable baseline learned eligibility ledger contains at least one eligible endpoint and the prior request lock contains its baseline_learned raw-order counterpart.
selection_semantics.order: ascending immutable selector_rank, then original_rank, then candidate_identity
selection_semantics.prior_candidate_deduplication: Exclude every selector candidate whose candidate identity appears in any prior delta-0.4 request-lock membership.
selection_semantics.prior_request_deduplication: Build the exact docking-request identity from target, canonical molecule, docking seed and evaluator. Exclude it when its request_id already appears in the prior delta-0.4 request lock.
selection_semantics.selection: Within each supported cell, select the first eligible selector-ranked candidate remaining after both prior deduplication rules.
selection_semantics.raw_counterpart: Reuse the already immutable baseline_learned raw-order request for that cell. Never add another raw learned request.
selection_semantics.unsupported_cell_abstention: If immutable eligibility is empty, preserve an explicit no_eligible_baseline_learned_candidate abstention. Ordering cannot change support.

authority.later_authorization_required: Explicitly authorize the exact sealed request-lock physical and payload SHA-256 and its exact call ceiling, with no retries, replacements or backfill.

payload.interpretation_limit: This prelock can establish only incremental eligible request coverage from an offline-selected ordering. It cannot establish docking utility, route recovery, autonomous optimization, final-benchmark performance or superiority over IVG.
